baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated accusatives at words 2-3 pair hamim with ghassaq under an exception construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hot-water branch of HMM and the pouring or wound-fluid branch of GHSQ form a two-part liquid mechanism: thermal assault is coupled with a contaminating outflow.

activation_trace.role: Hot water supplies the thermal and ingestible side of the paired mechanism.
Flowing or pouring discharge supplies the contaminating outflow joined to the hot liquid.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely names two opaque punishments.
changed_reading.after: The ayah coordinates a thermal liquid with a noxious outflow, making the pair a compact material system rather than two unrelated labels.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same two focus nouns at words 2-3 can activate convergent branches of blackening and darkness.
baseline_models.mechanism: HMM contributes soot-blackness and smoke while GHSQ contributes night darkness settling in; their coordination can therefore stage an attack on light and visibility alongside the liquid reading.

activation_trace.role: Blackness, charcoal, and smoke give the first noun a soot-darkening contribution.
Night darkness settling in makes the second noun complete the loss-of-light mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The pair is read only as two substances.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting branch reading makes the pair a soot-and-night blackout that closes visibility as well as supplying matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence assigns darkness a beneficial function: sleep is cessation and night is a covering. The focus pair's soot-blackness and settling darkness now resemble a corrupted night that encloses without giving rest or protection.

activation_trace.role: Soot-blackness makes the first focus noun the blackening component of a failed cover.
Settling night darkness makes the second focus noun resemble an enclosing but harmful night.
Stillness and rest supply the beneficial endpoint that the punitive darkness fails to deliver.
Night and its darkness provide the proper created analogue for the GHSQ darkness branch.
Covering with clothing gives normal night-darkness its protective function, which the focus pair reverses.

structural_cues: The focus coordinates two dark-capable nouns but supplies no rest term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restful cessation, night, covering, soot-blackness, and settling darkness; I infer a functional reversal from protective night to punitive enclosure. Alternatively, the shared darkness may be only imagistic resonance rather than a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: The dark branches simply intensify loss of visibility.
changed_reading.after: They stage a failed night: an enveloping darkness that withholds the rest and shelter darkness was created to provide.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 78:13-15, blazing heat and abundantly poured water participate in a productive sequence ending in growth. The focus recombines heat and flow but replaces productive water with noxious discharge, turning the pair into an anti-creation or sterile hydrothermal cycle.

activation_trace.role: Hot water anchors the focus pair in the same heat-and-water material domain as the provisioning sequence.
Pouring discharge preserves flow while corrupting the kind and outcome of the liquid.
Blazing luminous heat supplies a productive counterpart to the focus heat.
Ordinary water supplies the life-bearing liquid whose focus counterpart is hot and contaminated.
Abundant pouring supplies the flow pattern shared with the GHSQ outflow branch.
Plant growth supplies the productive endpoint conspicuously absent from the focus heat-and-flow pair.

structural_cues: 78:13-15 orders blazing lamp, poured water, and the purpose clause li-nukhrija bihi before grain and vegetation.
78:25 compresses a hot liquid and a flowing contaminant into one coordinated pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies productive heat, poured water, growth, hot water, and contaminating flow; I infer that the later pair reverses the earlier causal ecology. Alternatively, the repeated materials may contrast loosely without implying a reversed cycle.

changed_reading.before: The focus names two noxious liquids.
changed_reading.after: The pair is a de-creative parody of provision: heat and flow remain, but water no longer nourishes and pouring no longer culminates in life.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed appointment leads into a prepared watch-station, a return destination, and prolonged dwelling across extended periods. Within that temporal enclosure, the focus liquids read less like a single dose and more like the recurring intake or ambient regimen of the destination.

activation_trace.role: Hot water supplies one recurring material of the enclosed regimen.
Continuing outflow supplies the second recurring material of the regimen.
A known fixed time supplies the bounded entry point into the punitive sequence.
A watch-place or path makes the destination spatially prepared and controlled.
Return to an abode turns the punishment from an encounter into a destination.
Remaining in a place supplies persistence to the focus pair's availability.
Extended periods stretch the material experience beyond a momentary serving.

structural_cues: 78:17-23 moves from appointment to destination and then to prolonged residence before naming intake in 78:24-25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed onset, controlled destination, return, dwelling, long periods, and the focus liquids; I infer repeated or ambient exposure during residence. Alternatively, the liquids could be occasional episodes within the long stay rather than its standing regimen.

changed_reading.before: The pair is a momentary serving of two harmful liquids.
changed_reading.after: The pair becomes the recurring material environment of a watched destination occupied over extended periods.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding negation withholds experienced coolness and drink, while the focus exception supplies hot liquid and contaminating flow. The pair therefore occupies the grammatical slot of relief while materially defeating both cooling and drinking.

activation_trace.role: Hot water directly reverses the cooling expected from relief.
Flowing discharge gives the available liquid a contaminating rather than refreshing character.
Experiencing and undergoing make the denied and excepted items an embodied trial, not a visual inventory.
Cold opposed to heat supplies the relief category that hot water cancels.
Taking in liquid supplies the ordinary act whose only available objects become punitive.

structural_cues: 78:24 negates two coordinated accusatives and 78:25 follows with illa plus two coordinated accusatives.
The focus pair is grammatically offered where cooling and drink have just been denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies embodied tasting, denied coolness and drink, then hot water and discharge under illa; I infer counterfeit substitution, with available intake undoing the function of relief. Alternatively, illa may attach narrowly to drink rather than distribute each focus noun across both denied categories.

changed_reading.before: The two liquids are additional punishments listed after deprivation.
changed_reading.after: They are counterfeit relief: the only intake simultaneously occupies and destroys the categories of cooling and drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate label of recompense fitted to its counterpart is followed by denied accounting, exhaustive enumeration, and binding inscription. The focus liquids consequently read as entered and calibrated returns rather than arbitrary torments.

activation_trace.role: Hot water supplies the first concrete item whose judicial function is activated by the accounting sequence.
Noxious outflow supplies the second concrete item in the fitted return.
Reciprocating an act with its recompense assigns the focus materials a return-for-conduct function.
A measure equal to need or counterpart supplies calibration between conduct and consequence.
Counting and accounting identify the evaluative process the recipients failed to anticipate.
Exhaustive numerical enumeration prevents the fitted return from reading as rough or accidental.
Binding inscription supplies the durable record from which the concrete return can issue.

structural_cues: 78:26 immediately apposes jaza'an wifaqan to the focus pair.
78:27-29 moves from rejected accounting to exhaustive enumeration and a written record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concrete liquids, reciprocal recompense, matching measure, accounting, enumeration, and inscription; I infer that the materials embody a calibrated return. Alternatively, wifaq may qualify the penalty only in aggregate, without mapping either liquid to a particular deed.

changed_reading.before: The focus materials are arbitrary features of punishment.
changed_reading.after: They become itemized consequences issued from an exhaustive account and fitted to what preceded them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The tasting command in 78:30 reactivates the embodied intake of 78:24, while a second illa construction restricts every future increase to punishment. The first exception names what can be taken in; the second closes the future into more of the same punitive category.

activation_trace.role: Hot water supplies one concrete content for the later command to taste.
Noxious outflow supplies the second concrete content drawn into the later tasting command.
Undergoing or experiencing reconnects the focus liquids to an imperative cycle of embodied trial.
Increase and growth extend the focus experience forward rather than allowing it to terminate.
Painful punishment names the sole category into which the increase is allowed to develop.

structural_cues: Illa restricts the available objects in 78:25 and reappears to restrict future increase in 78:30.
The taste lexeme occurs before the focus in 78:24 and returns as an imperative in 78:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated tasting, two illa restrictions, and future increase only as punishment; I infer an intake-to-increase loop in which the focus pair is a recurring mode of escalation. Alternatively, the two restrictions can remain separate statements without a causal loop.

changed_reading.before: The focus exception is a closed list of two substances.
changed_reading.after: It opens into a recursive regimen: these are tasted now, and the only future development is further punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The protected group later receives a cup defined by its contents, filled to the top, within a gift register. Against that positive liquid allotment, the focus pair becomes an anti-cup: not absence of provision, but a fully inverted provision whose contents injure.

activation_trace.role: Hot water supplies one injurious content of the negative liquid allotment.
Contaminating outflow supplies the other injurious content of the negative allotment.
A cup identified together with what it contains provides the positive container-and-content counterpart.
Filling the cup to its top makes the positive provision abundant rather than merely available.
Giving and handing over place the full cup in a gift economy opposite the focus pair.

structural_cues: 78:31-36 forms a contrasting recipient block after 78:21-30.
Both blocks specify liquid provision, but only the later block names a full cup and gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies injurious focus liquids, a content-bearing full cup, and giving; I infer a contrast between negative allotment and abundant gift. Alternatively, the cup may contrast with the punishment scene generally rather than with the two focus nouns specifically.

changed_reading.before: The focus pair is simply the absence of a wholesome drink.
changed_reading.after: It is the damned counterpart of the full gifted cup: provision is not absent but qualitatively inverted at the level of its contents.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads coordination as a material process from rendering to bodily outflow and then links that process to fitted recompense and hand-produced action. The branches and return cues are packet-backed, but the process direction is reader-supplied; downstream prose should present it only as a grotesque material analogy, never as the lexical gloss of either noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 activates rendering under HMM and word 3 activates wound-like outflow under GHSQ; the two are directly coordinated.

activation_trace.role: Rendering fat or suet supplies a heat-driven bodily liquefaction image.
Yellow wound fluid and pouring supply the outflow that can follow the rendering image.
Equivalent measure lets the bodily process function analogically as a fitted return.
What the hands have earned supplies the agency whose consequence returns in materialized form.

changed_reading.before: The two objects are externally supplied liquids.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they resemble a self-materializing consequence: heat renders and the body runs, as what was produced by action returns as bodily matter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it lets HMM's imminence branch and GHSQ's onset-of-night branch cast a temporal shadow over nouns normally read materially. It remains anchored in both focus roots and explicit appointment and nearness cues, but downstream prose should retain hot water and noxious flow as the primary reading and label this only as secondary wordplay.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: HMM at word 2 has a branch of a matter drawing near or becoming due, while GHSQ at word 3 has a branch of darkness entering.

activation_trace.role: Nearness, arrival, and becoming due give the first noun a secondary temporal edge.
Night darkness entering supplies an onset image for the second noun.
A known time makes due arrival a live temporal mechanism in the surah.
Temporal nearness of an ending strengthens the focus HMM branch of imminence.

changed_reading.before: The focus pair has only a material register.
changed_reading.after: A contained secondary register lets the due punishment arrive as darkness sets in: material torment is shadowed by appointed imminence.

strongest_changes: The 78:24 exception turned the pair into counterfeit relief: the only intake occupies and destroys cooling and drink.
The heat-water-growth sequence of 78:13-15 recast the focus heat and flow as a sterile reversal of created provision.
The fitted recompense and accounting sequence of 78:26-29 made the liquids calibrated, itemized returns rather than arbitrary torments.
The repeated tasting and illa of 78:30 extended a two-item exception into a recursively increasing punitive regimen.
The full gifted cup of 78:34-36 made the focus pair an inverted allotment rather than mere lack.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly supplied proper functions for the focus materials and images: night covers and rests, heat and water grow life, accounting fits returns, and a full cup is given. Those systems changed the two focus nouns into concentrated anti-provision while preserving several coexisting material, visual, temporal, and judicial readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntactic scope of illa may be narrow to drink or may distribute the focus pair across both denied coolness and drink.
Wifaq securely qualifies the recompense, but the packet does not assign either focus liquid to a particular deed.
The self-rendering and imminent-arrival outliers depend on branch-level analogy and should not displace the primary hot-water and noxious-flow reading.
